model.architecture: A NaViT-style dynamic-resolution SigLIP vision encoder + the tiny ERNIE-4.5-0.3B decoder, ~0.9B parameters total, supporting 109 languages; a task-prompted document-parsing / OCR model.

variants.quantization: Decoder ERNIE-4.5-0.3B fp16 weights (+ fp16 externalized embedder); vision encoder int8 weights; adapter int8

platform_notes: Task-prompted model: the prompt selects the task (OCR:, Table Recognition:, Formula Recognition:, Chart Recognition:, Spotting:, Seal Recognition:).
Context (KV cache) 4096; image resized by the runtime to 560x560 -> 400 image tokens.
Decoder kept at fp16 (~460 MB extra) because this 0.36 B decoder is unusually quantization-sensitive: int4 and integer-compute int8 measurably corrupt transcription.
Vision tower has zero FLEX/CUSTOM ops (GPU-clean); corr 1.0 fp32 / 0.9975 shipped int8 vs the reference.
M-RoPE replaced by fast_vlm's sequential positions: identical for text tokens; an A/B eager test showed no quality loss on OCR/table tasks for image tokens.
Desktop macOS CPU table output is byte-identical to the full-precision eager reference, including the <fcel>/<nl> cell tokens.
Gallery UI on the Pixel 8a renders the model's structured table markup (<fcel>/<nl>) as plain text.
Galaxy S26 GPU gate covers engine creation and the text path only (no image in the gate prompt); the vision path on the GPU is not measured there. XNNPACK takes 1 of 5 nodes in main.
Card claims the same file runs on macOS, Linux and Windows (Linux/Windows not measured on the card).

known_issues: A generic instruction such as 'describe this image' returns nothing — the prompt must be one of the task prompts.
Aspect ratio: the runtime resizes to a fixed square, so extreme aspect ratios (very wide single lines) get distorted; feed roughly page/paragraph-shaped crops.
One image per chat: a second image in the same chat degrades (context bleed from the first turn was observed on CPU).
Scope: recognition component only; no layout-detection front-end, so best on single elements or simple pages.
Swift runtime: bring the engine up with the vision modality only — requesting .all fails at session creation on bundles without an audio section.

2026-08-30 tokenizer-only change (weights unchanged): accuracy figures and on-device rows were measured on the previous file; the on-device gate has not been re-run. Re-download if downloaded before 2026-08-30.

Before 2026-08-30 the SentencePiece control-symbol specials meant the </s> after each history turn reached the model as several tokens; multi-turn prompts now tokenize as upstream. Single-turn prompts were unaffected.
